title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: LFVCR (Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression) R package regression high-dimensional predictors whose effects may vary low-dimensional latent structure. estimates latent factors, constructs factor--feature interactions, fits expanded design sparse group lasso. Two factor-extraction methods available: LF_VCR() estimates factors Principal Orthogonal complEment Thresholding (POET). LF_VCR_ae() estimates factors single-hidden-layer autoencoder.

title: Latent Factor Varying-Coefficient Regression
text: binary outcome, set categorical = TRUE provide outcome exactly two distinct values. Additional adjustment variables can supplied covariate.
code: library(LFVCR)  set.seed(1) n <- 100 p <- 20 X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), nrow = n, ncol = p) y <- 0.8 * X[, 1] - 0.5 * X[, 2] + rnorm(n)  fit <- LF_VCR(   X = X,   y = y,   number.K = 2,   nfold = 5,   matrix = "vad" )  fit$beta

title: Fit LF-VCR with POET latent factors — LF_VCR
text: X numeric matrix observations rows predictors columns. y numeric outcome vector one value per row X. number.K number latent factors extract. covariate optional matrix adjustment covariates. nfold number cross-validation folds used sparsegl::cv.sparsegl(). matrix POET thresholding scale: "cor" correlation matrix "vad" covariance matrix. categorical Logical; use binomial model TRUE Gaussian model FALSE.
